           BEFORE THE CORPORATION COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF OKLAHOMA

         IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF )
         OKLAHOMA GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY )
         FOR COMMISSION APPROVAL OF ELECTRIC )                      CASE NO. PUD 2026-000031
         SERVICE AGREEMENTS AND PREAPPROVAL
                                             )
         OF CAPACITY PURCHASE AGREEMENTS
         PURSUANT TO 17 O.S. 286(C)          )




                                  GOOGLE’S WITNESS AND EXHIBIT LIST


                COMES NOW GOOGLE LLC (“Google”), pursuant to the Commission’s Preliminary

         Order No. 758317 issued June 11, 2026, and submits this Witness and Exhibit List. Google

         identifies Adrian J. Kimbrough as its expert witness and identifies the following as potential

         exhibits for use at the hearing on the merits:

            1. All prefiled testimony, including exhibits and schedules attached or referenced therein,

                filed by any witness on behalf of any party in this proceeding, including any errata,

                amendments, or supplements thereto.

            2. All other pleadings or documents filed with the Oklahoma Corporation Commission in this

                proceeding prior to the closing of the evidentiary record of the hearing on the merits.

            3. All data requests, interrogatories, and other forms of discovery issued by Google, the

                Applicant, the Commission Staff, the Attorney General, or any other intervenor in this

                proceeding, together with the responses and all attachments thereto, regardless of

                confidential or highly sensitive confidential designation.

            4. All workpapers of witnesses for Google, the Applicant, the Commission Staff, the Attorney

                General, or any other intervenor in this proceeding.


                                                                                                          1

            5. All exhibits, whether marked as evidence, provided for demonstrative purposes, and/or

                provided for impeachment purposes, introduced by any other party at the hearing on the

                merits, to the extent such materials have not been excluded due to an objection.

            6. All documents, charts, graphs, or other materials specifically identified in any other party's

                timely filed Exhibit List, to the extent such materials have not been excluded due to an

                objection.

            7. All relevant case law, state statutes, constitutional provisions, opinions of the Oklahoma

                Attorney General, and rules and orders of the Oklahoma Corporation Commission

                applicable to any issue raised in this proceeding.

            8. All testimony, citations, and source materials referenced in Google's testimony.

            9. Any and all public filings and submissions heretofore made by the Applicant, or its

                affiliates, with the Commission Court Clerk, the Commission Staff, the Southwest Power

                Pool, or Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.

            10. Publicly disclosed information relating to any issues raised in this proceeding, including,

                but not limited to, public information relating to the Applicant.

            11. Exhibits necessary or helpful in supporting any oral surrebuttal testimony offered in this

                cause by Google.

            12. Exhibits necessary or helpful in impeaching or cross-examining any oral surrebuttal or sur-

                surrebuttal testimony allowed in this cause by other parties.

            Google reserves the right to amend or supplement its Exhibit List as may be required by the

         proceedings.
